facts.fact: 次日早晨她缠在睡袍改成的被子里、抱着斧头醒来，想过再去敲门叫邻居小声点，还是没胆
facts.anchor: I considered knocking on my neighbour’s door again to ask her to keep it down

facts.fact: 她先去试卧室门，铰链吱呀作响，于是把昨夜归为半睡半醒的幻觉
facts.anchor: I must have left it ajar when I went to bed.

facts.fact: 天亮后的房子让她处处不适，她把这种感觉比作伪装成兰花的螳螂、伪装的坟墓
facts.anchor: It’s a praying mantis camouflaged as an orchid.

facts.fact: 她决定用一块便宜地毯来让 1b 变“像家”，换不了风挡也换不了床垫
facts.anchor: But I could shell out a little for a cheap rug.

facts.fact: 她进了 Carlinsrest 一家古董店，店员头也不抬说“苏格兰文学在左边”
facts.anchor: “Scottish books to the left,” said the man, not even looking up from his novel.

facts.fact: 后屋她撞上镜子里自己的脸，又撞响一只花瓶
facts.anchor: My reflection stared back at me from a tall gilt mirror leant against the wall.

facts.fact: 地毯标价四位数，她当场掏出手机在网上找便宜的同款，被店员撞见
facts.anchor: There were four figures on that tag!

facts.fact: 店员冷笑建议她去格拉斯哥城外的大超市买，她赌气买下最小的羊皮地毯，且拒绝收据
facts.anchor: “You should check one of the bigger supermarkets just outside Glasgow.
